the use of UV-light and FUdR as a means to enhance the frequency with which cells are transformed with exogenously supplied DNA.
the development of a simple, efficient and reproducible method for the genetic transformation of animal cells, using the plasmid pSV2-neo as a selectable marker.
the use of DNA damaging agents to enhance the frequency and/or the efficiency of genetic transformation in mammalian cells.

the transformation frequency is increased by damage to the host DNA.
